recommendation.why: Dominant pale bill-root cuff is a discrete mesh with a normalized UV chart and one populated face slot. A dedicated region-specific map/normal/roughness design can change this large head highlight area while preserving the useful bill and optic geometry. The tested all-family mild recolor was insufficient; this proposal replaces the dominant cuff material response/chart, not the whole palette.
recommendation.confidence: Moderate technical feasibility; low-to-moderate confidence of useful whole-size artistic gain until actual matched renders. Shape and enclosure mismatch remain significant.
recommendation.scope_ceiling: Existing exact mesh successor copies and compatible packed maps only. No new geometric parts, shape edits, cavity closure, stance changes, optical graph edits or body/feet finish changes.
recommendation.fail_fast: If root wants literal fitted plates or closer head contour rather than improved surface appearance, this plan is insufficient. If design01 only looks darker or more mottled, stop or root-direct one substantive correction; do not count it as successful source construction.

source_scale_surface_design.design01: Dedicated cuff and bill chart set, with one supporting trim response only if needed. The cuff must visibly cease to dominate as a smooth pale sheet at whole size. The new head should read as worked, regionally differentiated metal under both lights while keeping useful bill/optic contours.
source_scale_surface_design.basecolor: Author a bounded chart palette from visually observed plate face/edge regions, with relatively large regional patches and source-scale interrupted seams. No full-art crop pasted as physical albedo, no uniform dark filter across all head parts or body. Color values are proposals because illumination and stylized illustration are inseparable in source pixels.
source_scale_surface_design.formed_normal: Create a new tangent-space raster normal map from a small authored height/gradient field aligned to source-observed sheet courses and actual UV face coverage. Target a few large sheet-scale normal changes visible across the cuff highlight, not fine periodic noise. Begin with roughly3-7degree localized normal-direction differences; this is an experiment parameter, not source measurement. Keep it bounded so a broad face does not become rippled rock or padded scales.
source_scale_surface_design.roughness: Correlate medium-rough face patches and broader worked/aged areas with narrower smoother rubbed borders, using a few source-scale bands rather than global roughness change. Proposed test range face0.45-0.68 and selective rubbed boundary0.28-0.42; literal physical values are unknown. Avoid a broad coherent white specular plateau or a fully matte black featureless cap.
source_scale_surface_design.metallicity: Use piece-specific compatible metal response; do not ramp metallic on every material family. Distinguish oxidized/coated-looking areas from bare rubbed metal only as a visual proposal, not proof of source composition.
source_scale_surface_design.maps_and_graph: New separately named packed BaseColor/ORM/tangent normal rasters, deterministic bytes and correct color-space labels. A copied simple Principled graph with direct image bindings is the final graph; no renderer material override, live procedural-only bump or complex unsupported nodes. Maximum cuff/bill/optional-trim chart classes; share deterministic geometry/masks across eras.
source_scale_surface_design.virtual_seam_boundary: Appearance bands may suggest sheet divisions within an existing cuff face, but they cannot claim physical extra plate topology. No fabricated hole/cavity dark patches or painted missing enclosure. Silhouette, actual overlaps, cavity depth and profile stay exactly as input.

era_mapping.maker: Dark slate/black worked head faces with restrained warm bare-edge/trim response, less discontinuous contact wear and coherent fabrication finish; dark non-awakened optic untouched. Source image still has texture; no sterile chrome target.
era_mapping.mechanic: Same chart lineage, a few broader aged face patches and interrupted boundary abrasion/contact variations, with one small verified serviced region if actual geometry supports it. Dark optic untouched; no whole-head orange/grime wash.
era_mapping.advanced_builder: Inherit Mechanic chart wear locations on unchanged parts; selected localized warmer bare-metal forehead/trim response is allowed where pinned Advanced/canon head supports it. Retain restrained warm optic exactly. Do not manufacture a source-white core or light entire head.

direct_source_projection_option.recommendation: DEFER_OR_REJECT_FOR_DESIGN01. Source-directed authored charts have better bounded feasibility than a projected finished illustration.
direct_source_projection_option.risk: Single-view source pixels already contain highlight, environment color, occlusion, contours and deep shadows. Projection can double-light the metal, copy background, paint optics/holes onto solids and fail on opposite views. Exact UV-to-source mapping cannot fix geometry/contour disagreement.
direct_source_projection_option.only_if_root_explicitly_selects: At most one manually masked forehead/bill material patch from the already pinned original source image, projected only onto separately named successor copies with a written source->face->UV transform. Preserve source binary and rights/status. Use a packed newly named chart image; never modify source artwork or source maps.
mask_rules: Exclude background and dilate valid material pixels inward at source contours
Exclude optic/emission, holes, mouth cavity, foreground/background objects and strong specular/black cast-shadow areas
Use an authored neutral response fallback at unseen angles; no mirror-paste to unknown opposite side
Bind independently identified near/far mesh faces; do not use arbitrary automatic projection through the whole head
direct_source_projection_option.light_rules: Treat projected RGB explicitly as view-dependent appearance research, not calibrated albedo. Attenuate/remove broad baked illumination only by a documented inference; if it cannot be separated convincingly within the allotted first-whole window, reject the projection rather than layering more shader tricks.
direct_source_projection_option.tests: Both neutral/exhibit whole views plus near/far side and rear/head closeups must show no background bleed, mirrored source silhouettes, black painted cavities or double highlights before root retention. Projection alone cannot establish three-era portable material fidelity.

preservation_and_evaluated_binding: Original receiving geometry, world transforms/parents/stance, UV arrays/names, material slot counts and references, polygon face indices, graphs and packed source-map/image IDs remain held. Old data/graphs/images are never mutated.

Create separately named exact mesh and object copies only for selected active visible head contributors, with matching modifier state and transforms; DATA-link copied successor material graphs to those new meshes. Declare exact original render/layer hides and preserve global viewport flags.
Final input must be re-inventoried per era; diagnostic retained02 names/slots are evidence, not automatic permission to retire final objects. Missing/renamed/extra contributors cause PAUSE.
Verify actual evaluated faces use successor material/image bindings, UV/corner data and real packed bytes. Native name/slot metadata or a temporary render override is not proof.

For later root-approved portable delivery, decode GLB material texture indices/embedded images and compare actual map bytes or correctly transformed pixels, material-indexed face triangles and UV corners. No placeholder texture, fabricated renderer/GLB evidence or renewed cache theory.

feasibility_limits: Normal/roughness charts can interrupt smooth specular dominance and supply worked-metal surface reading; they cannot recover source head shape, fitted outer enclosure, recessed cavities or exact plate relief from a broad cuff
Source look may still remain generic because dominant contour/enclosure mismatch persists; useful local surface progress is not final likeness acceptance
Dark Maker/Mechanic and warm restrained Advanced optics are a hard invariant; surface maps must not duplicate or obscure them
Existing UV chart distortion and single-view reference lighting restrict projection and response accuracy; report rather than expand unboundedly
